item.tib: gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud rgya che rol pa las drag po gting rdzogs byad ma 'bum zlog
item.coloph: ces lha rgod thog pa'i zlog pa byad ma 'bum rdug (zlog) 'dikhyung po'i gdung 'dzin lha dbang sku mched gyi bskur (kyis bskul) ngor/ mdo smad mu la drung mu yi (yis) gdan sa dpal gyi steng chen pho brang lhun grub rtse yi yang dben du/ chu pho 'brug gi lo yi yar tshes bzang po la sbyar bas bkra shis bon bstan dar rgyas bde legs 'grub 'gyur cig/
